cc.zh: 儘管交通繁忙，我們還是準時抵達機場。

cc.en: Despite being warned twice, he kept using his phone in class.
cc.zh: 儘管被警告兩次，他仍在課堂上用手機。

cc.en: Despite the fact that he is rich, he lives very simply.
cc.zh: 儘管他很有錢，卻過得非常簡樸。

cc.en: In spite of her injury, she finished the race in second place.
cc.zh: 儘管受傷，她仍以第二名完賽。

cc.en: They enjoyed the picnic in spite of the cold wind.
cc.zh: 儘管寒風刺骨，他們仍享受了野餐。

cc.en: Everyone is welcome to join, regardless of age or experience.
cc.zh: 無論年齡或經驗，歡迎所有人參加。

cc.en: The company treats all customers equally, regardless of how much they spend.
cc.zh: 這家公司對所有顧客一視同仁，不論消費多少。

cc.en: He decided to go ahead regardless of the risks involved.
cc.zh: 他決定不顧相關風險繼續進行。

cc.en: The forecast predicted rain, but we went hiking regardless.
cc.zh: 天氣預報說會下雨，但我們還是照樣去爬山。

cc.en: Her parents objected, but she married him regardless.
cc.zh: 她父母反對，但她還是嫁給了他。

cc.en: Notwithstanding the bad weather, the ceremony was held outdoors.
cc.zh: 儘管天氣惡劣，典禮仍在戶外舉行。

cc.en: The project went ahead, notwithstanding the objections of local residents.
cc.zh: 儘管當地居民反對，計畫仍繼續進行。

cc.en: The company made a profit, albeit a small one.
cc.zh: 這家公司獲利了，儘管金額不大。

cc.en: He agreed to help, albeit reluctantly.
cc.zh: 他答應幫忙，儘管不太情願。

cc.en: Granted, the plan has flaws, but it is still our best option.
cc.zh: 的確，這個計畫有缺點，但它仍是最佳選項。

cc.en: Granted that the price is high, the quality is worth it.
cc.zh: 儘管價格高，品質是值得的。

cc.en: Admittedly, I made a mistake, but it was not entirely my fault.
cc.zh: 誠然，我犯了錯，但這不完全是我的錯。

cc.en: The results are, admittedly, far from perfect.
cc.zh: 這些結果誠然遠非完美。

cc.en: True, the car is old, but it still runs perfectly well.
cc.zh: 沒錯，這車很舊，但它仍跑得好好的。

cc.en: It is true that he is strict, but his students respect him.
cc.zh: 他確實嚴格，但學生們尊敬他。

cc.en: The food was bad, but at least the service was friendly.
cc.zh: 食物很差，但至少服務很親切。

cc.en: It will take at least three hours to finish the report.
cc.zh: 完成這份報告至少要三小時。

cc.en: The movie is too long. That said, the acting is superb.
cc.zh: 這部電影太長了。話雖如此，演技一流。

cc.en: I rarely eat dessert. That said, I can never refuse chocolate cake.
cc.zh: 我很少吃甜點。話雖如此，我從不拒絕巧克力蛋糕。

cc.en: The hotel is far from downtown. Having said that, the view is amazing.
cc.zh: 這家飯店離市中心很遠。話雖如此，景色很迷人。

cc.en: He says he was busy. Be that as it may, he should have called.
cc.zh: 他說他很忙。即便如此，他也應該打個電話。

cc.en: The tickets were sold out, but we went to the stadium anyway.
cc.zh: 門票賣完了，但我們還是去了體育場。

cc.en: I don't need a new phone. Anyway, I can't afford one.
cc.zh: 我不需要新手機。反正，我也買不起。

cc.en: It was too late to apologize, but he called her anyhow.
cc.zh: 道歉已經太遲了，但他還是打了電話給她。

cc.en: Anyhow, let's get back to the main point of the meeting.
cc.zh: 總之，我們回到會議的重點吧。

cc.en: Don't be too hard on him; after all, he is only a child.
cc.zh: 別對他太嚴厲；畢竟，他只是個孩子。

cc.en: The exam was not so difficult after all.
cc.zh: 這次考試終究沒那麼難。

cc.en: She decided to come to the party after all.
cc.zh: 她最後還是決定來參加派對。

cc.en: It was a long trip; at any rate, we arrived safely.
cc.zh: 這是一段漫長的旅程；無論如何，我們安全抵達了。

cc.en: At any rate, the decision has already been made.
cc.zh: 無論如何，決定已經做出來了。

cc.en: The store may be closed, but in any case we can order online.
cc.zh: 商店可能關了，但無論如何我們可以網購。

cc.en: In any case, I will call you as soon as I arrive.
cc.zh: 無論如何，我一到就會打給你。

cc.en: The team lost; the fans nevertheless cheered loudly for them.
cc.zh: 球隊輸了；儘管如此，粉絲仍大聲為他們加油。

cc.en: He did not study for the test; therefore, he failed.
cc.zh: 他沒有為考試讀書；因此，他不及格。

cc.en: The road is closed for repairs. Therefore, traffic is being diverted.
cc.zh: 道路封閉維修。因此，車流正在改道。

cc.en: Prices rose sharply and demand therefore dropped.
cc.zh: 價格大漲，需求因此下降。

cc.en: The factory closed, thus leaving hundreds of workers unemployed.
cc.zh: 工廠關閉，使數百名工人失業。

cc.en: Fewer trees are being cut; thus, the forest is slowly recovering.
cc.zh: 砍伐的樹木減少；因此，森林正慢慢恢復。

cc.en: The team trained harder and thus improved their results.
cc.zh: 這支隊伍更努力訓練，因而成績提升。

cc.en: The town has little industry; hence, many young people move away.
cc.zh: 這座城鎮工業少；因此，許多年輕人搬離。

cc.en: He lost his passport, hence the delay in his departure.
cc.zh: 他丟了護照，所以才延後出發。

cc.en: Hence the need for stricter safety rules.
cc.zh: 因此需要更嚴格的安全規範。

cc.en: It rained for a week; consequently, the river flooded the village.
cc.zh: 下了一週的雨；結果，河水淹沒了村莊。

cc.en: She missed the deadline and consequently lost the contract.
cc.zh: 她錯過了期限，結果失去了合約。

cc.en: The bridge collapsed, and as a result, the highway was closed for months.
cc.zh: 橋塌了，結果公路關閉了好幾個月。

cc.en: As a result of the storm, thousands of homes lost power.
cc.zh: 由於暴風雨，數千戶住家停電。

cc.en: He ignored the warnings and, as a consequence, lost all his savings.
cc.zh: 他忽視警告，結果失去了所有積蓄。

cc.en: As a consequence of the strike, no trains ran today.
cc.zh: 由於罷工，今天沒有火車行駛。

cc.en: The rules have changed; please adjust your plans accordingly.
cc.zh: 規定已改變；請據此調整你的計畫。

cc.en: He was told the meeting was urgent and acted accordingly.
cc.zh: 他被告知會議緊急，便據此行動。

cc.en: She resigned, thereby ending twenty years of service.
cc.zh: 她辭職，從而結束了二十年的服務。

cc.en: The new law raises taxes, thereby reducing the deficit.
cc.zh: 新法提高稅收，從而減少赤字。

cc.en: He skipped breakfast, thereby saving ten minutes.
cc.zh: 他沒吃早餐，藉此省下十分鐘。

cc.en: It was getting dark, so we decided to head home.
cc.zh: 天漸漸黑了，所以我們決定回家。

cc.en: The store was closed, so I couldn't buy milk.
cc.zh: 商店關了，所以我買不到牛奶。

cc.en: Speak louder so that everyone in the back can hear you.
cc.zh: 說大聲一點，好讓後面的人都聽得到。

cc.en: He saved money for years so that he could buy a house.
cc.zh: 他存了多年的錢，為的是能買房子。

cc.en: The teacher repeated the rule in order that no one would misunderstand.
cc.zh: 老師重複了規則，以免有人誤解。

cc.en: We left early in order that we might avoid the traffic.
cc.zh: 我們提早出發，以便避開車潮。

cc.en: In order to pass the exam, you must practice every day.
cc.zh: 為了通過考試，你必須每天練習。

cc.en: She moved to Taipei in order to find a better job.
cc.zh: 她搬到台北是為了找更好的工作。

cc.en: He whispered so as not to wake the baby.
cc.zh: 他輕聲說話，以免吵醒嬰兒。

cc.en: Read the instructions carefully so as to avoid mistakes.
cc.zh: 仔細閱讀說明，以避免錯誤。

cc.en: We aim to reduce waste. To this end, plastic bags are now banned.
cc.zh: 我們致力於減少垃圾。為此，塑膠袋現已禁用。

cc.en: The city wants cleaner air; to this end, it is adding bike lanes.
cc.zh: 這座城市想要更乾淨的空氣；為此，正在增設自行車道。

cc.en: The company hired more staff with a view to expanding overseas.
cc.zh: 這家公司增聘員工，以期拓展海外業務。

cc.en: He wrote the number down lest he should forget it.
cc.zh: 他把號碼寫下來，以免忘記。

cc.en: Speak softly lest the baby wake up.
cc.zh: 小聲說話，以免嬰兒醒來。

cc.en: She hid the letter lest her parents find it.
cc.zh: 她把信藏起來，以免父母發現。

cc.en: He didn't tell the truth for fear that he would be punished.
cc.zh: 他沒說實話，因為怕被處罰。

cc.en: The flight was canceled because of the heavy fog.
cc.zh: 由於大霧，航班取消了。

cc.en: Just because it is cheap doesn't mean it is bad.
cc.zh: 便宜不代表就不好。

cc.en: Since you are already here, you might as well stay for dinner.
cc.zh: 既然你已經來了，不如留下來吃晚餐。

cc.en: Since the shop was closed, we went to another one.
cc.zh: 由於那家店關了，我們去了另一家。

cc.en: As it was late, we decided to take a taxi home.
cc.zh: 由於時間晚了，我們決定搭計程車回家。

cc.en: As the population grows, the demand for housing increases.
cc.zh: 隨著人口成長，住房需求增加。

cc.en: He must be tired, for he has been working since dawn.
cc.zh: 他一定很累，因為他從天亮就開始工作。

cc.en: Now that the exams are over, we can finally relax.
cc.zh: 既然考試結束了，我們終於可以放鬆了。

cc.en: Now that you mention it, I do remember seeing him there.
cc.zh: 既然你提到了，我確實記得在那裡見過他。

cc.en: Seeing that nobody objected, the chairman closed the meeting.
cc.zh: 既然沒人反對，主席就結束了會議。

cc.en: The two plans differ in that one costs far more.
cc.zh: 這兩個計畫的不同在於其中一個貴得多。

cc.en: The test is unfair in that it favors native speakers.
cc.zh: 這項測驗不公平，因為它偏向母語人士。

cc.en: He is lucky in that he has supportive parents.
cc.zh: 他很幸運，因為他有支持他的父母。

cc.en: Given that she is new, her performance has been impressive.
cc.zh: 考量到她是新人，她的表現令人印象深刻。

cc.en: Given that it is raining, the match will probably be postponed.
cc.zh: 鑑於正在下雨，比賽可能會延後。

cc.en: Given the circumstances, the team did remarkably well.
cc.zh: 考量到當時情況，這支隊伍表現非常好。

cc.en: Given his age, his memory is surprisingly sharp.
cc.zh: 以他的年紀來說，他的記憶力驚人地好。

cc.en: Considering the traffic, we had better leave an hour early.
cc.zh: 考慮到交通，我們最好提早一小時出發。

cc.en: She did well, considering that it was her first attempt.
cc.zh: 考慮到這是她第一次嘗試，她表現得不錯。

cc.en: Owing to a technical problem, the website is temporarily unavailable.
cc.zh: 由於技術問題，網站暫時無法使用。

cc.en: The match was delayed owing to heavy rain.
cc.zh: 由於大雨，比賽延後。

cc.en: The delay was due to an accident on the highway.
cc.zh: 延誤是由於高速公路上的一場事故。

cc.en: Due to rising costs, the museum has raised its ticket prices.
cc.zh: 由於成本上升，博物館提高了票價。

cc.en: The school was closed on account of the typhoon.
cc.zh: 由於颱風，學校停課了。

cc.en: He retired early on account of poor health.
cc.zh: 他因健康不佳而提早退休。

cc.en: Thanks to your help, we finished the project ahead of schedule.
cc.zh: 多虧你的幫忙，我們提前完成了專案。

cc.en: Thanks to the new bridge, the trip now takes only ten minutes.
cc.zh: 多虧了新橋，現在車程只要十分鐘。

cc.en: In view of the recent complaints, the policy will be reviewed.
cc.zh: 鑑於近期的投訴，這項政策將被重新檢討。

cc.en: In light of new evidence, the case has been reopened.
cc.zh: 鑑於新證據，此案已重新展開調查。

cc.en: The bridge is unsafe. For this reason, it will be closed to traffic.
cc.zh: 這座橋不安全。因此，它將禁止通行。

cc.en: He practiced every day. That is why he won the competition.
cc.zh: 他每天練習。這就是他贏得比賽的原因。

cc.en: Higher wages raise costs, which in turn push up prices.
cc.zh: 工資上漲提高成本，進而推高物價。

cc.en: She helped me, and I, in turn, helped her brother.
cc.zh: 她幫了我，而我也轉而幫了她弟弟。

cc.en: Each student in turn read a paragraph aloud.
cc.zh: 每位學生輪流朗讀一段。

cc.en: The house is too small; moreover, it is far from the station.
cc.zh: 這房子太小了；此外，它離車站很遠。

cc.en: The job is well paid. Moreover, it offers excellent training.
cc.zh: 這份工作薪水好。此外，它還提供優良的訓練。

cc.en: The plan is too costly. Furthermore, it would take years to complete.
cc.zh: 這個計畫太昂貵。此外，它需要好幾年才能完成。

cc.en: Smoking harms your lungs; furthermore, it affects those around you.
cc.zh: 吸菸傷害你的肺；此外，也影響周遭的人。

cc.en: In addition to English, she speaks French and Japanese fluently.
cc.zh: 除了英語，她還能流利地說法語和日語。

cc.en: The hotel offers free breakfast. In addition, guests may use the pool.
cc.zh: 這家飯店提供免費早餐。此外，房客可使用泳池。

cc.en: The course covers grammar. Additionally, students practice speaking every week.
cc.zh: 這門課涵蓋文法。此外，學生每週練習口說。

cc.en: I don't want to go out; besides, it's raining.
cc.zh: 我不想出門；再說，正在下雨。

cc.en: Besides being a great teacher, she is also a talented writer.
cc.zh: 除了是位好老師，她還是個有才華的作家。

cc.en: Who else was at the party besides Tom?
cc.zh: 除了湯姆，派對上還有誰？

cc.en: The restaurant serves great food and also has a lovely view.
cc.zh: 這家餐廳食物很棒，也有美麗的景觀。

cc.en: The school teaches art as well as science and math.
cc.zh: 這所學校除了教理科和數學，也教藝術。

cc.en: She is a doctor as well as a mother of three.
cc.zh: 她既是醫生，也是三個孩子的媽媽。

cc.en: Not only did he win the race, but he also broke the record.
cc.zh: 他不僅贏了比賽，還打破了紀錄。

cc.en: The book is not only informative but also entertaining.
cc.zh: 這本書不僅資訊豐富，也很有趣。

cc.en: The trip was tiring, not to mention expensive.
cc.zh: 這趟旅行很累人，更別說花費高昂了。

cc.en: He speaks three languages, not to mention his skill in music.
cc.zh: 他會說三種語言，更別提他的音樂才能。

cc.en: He can barely walk, let alone run a marathon.
cc.zh: 他幾乎無法走路，更別說跑馬拉松了。

cc.en: I can't afford a bike, let alone a car.
cc.zh: 我連自行車都買不起，更別說汽車了。

cc.en: She wouldn't speak to him, much less forgive him.
cc.zh: 她連跟他說話都不肯，更別說原諒他了。

cc.en: I have never seen snow, much less skied on it.
cc.zh: 我從沒見過雪，更別說滑雪了。

cc.en: He never reads newspapers, still less academic journals.
cc.zh: 他從不讀報紙，更別說學術期刊了。

cc.en: The hotel was cheap and clean; what is more, it was near the beach.
cc.zh: 這家飯店便宜又乾淨；更棒的是，它靠近海灘。

cc.en: I lost my wallet, and on top of that, I missed the last train.
cc.zh: 我丟了錢包，更糟的是，還錯過了最後一班火車。

cc.en: Be honest, be kind, and above all, be yourself.
cc.zh: 要誠實，要善良，最重要的是，做你自己。

cc.en: Above all, remember to stay calm during the exam.
cc.zh: 最重要的是，記得在考試時保持冷靜。

cc.en: The results were disappointing; indeed, they were the worst in years.
cc.zh: 結果令人失望；事實上，是多年來最差的。

cc.en: It is indeed a great honor to be here tonight.
cc.zh: 今晚能在這裡確實是極大的榮幸。

cc.en: He is not a stranger; in fact, he is my cousin.
cc.zh: 他不是陌生人；事實上，他是我表哥。

cc.en: The test was easy. In fact, I finished it in twenty minutes.
cc.zh: 考試很簡單。事實上，我二十分鐘就寫完了。

cc.en: I know the author well; as a matter of fact, we went to school together.
cc.zh: 我很熟那位作者；事實上，我們是同學。

cc.en: I thought the movie would be boring, but it was actually quite good.
cc.zh: 我以為電影會很無聊，但其實相當好看。

cc.en: Actually, I have never been to Japan.
cc.zh: 其實，我從沒去過日本。

cc.en: The students enjoyed the trip, the museum visit in particular.
cc.zh: 學生們很享受這次旅行，尤其是參觀博物館。

cc.en: Nothing in particular happened at the meeting.
cc.zh: 會議上沒發生什麼特別的事。

cc.en: Traffic is heavy in Taipei, particularly during rush hour.
cc.zh: 台北交通繁忙，尤其是尖峰時段。

cc.en: I love fruit, especially mangoes in summer.
cc.zh: 我愛吃水果，尤其是夏天的芒果。

cc.en: Several countries, notably Japan, have aging populations.
cc.zh: 好幾個國家，特別是日本，面臨人口老化。

cc.en: The new rule means, in effect, that no one can leave early.
cc.zh: 這條新規定實際上意味著沒人能提早離開。

cc.en: The company has, in effect, stopped hiring.
cc.zh: 這家公司實際上已經停止招聘。

cc.en: In essence, the two proposals are the same.
cc.zh: 本質上，這兩項提案是相同的。

cc.en: The two models are essentially identical except for the color.
cc.zh: 這兩款除了顏色之外基本上一模一樣。

cc.en: The new policy will certainly affect small businesses.
cc.zh: 新政策無疑會影響小型企業。

cc.en: She is undoubtedly the most gifted student in the class.
cc.zh: 她無疑是班上最有天賦的學生。

cc.en: Undoubtedly, the Internet has changed the way we learn.
cc.zh: 毫無疑問，網路改變了我們學習的方式。

cc.en: Obviously, we cannot finish the project without more funding.
cc.zh: 顯然，沒有更多資金我們無法完成這項專案。

cc.en: Clearly, the current system is not working.
cc.zh: 顯然，目前的制度行不通。

cc.en: Evidently, no one had told him about the change of plans.
cc.zh: 顯然，沒有人告訴他計畫改變了。

cc.en: Of course, not everyone agrees with this view.
cc.zh: 當然，並非每個人都同意這個看法。

cc.en: Needless to say, the party was a great success.
cc.zh: 不用說，派對非常成功。

cc.en: His behavior at the dinner was rude, to say the least.
cc.zh: 他在晚餐時的行為至少可以說是無禮。

cc.en: Many animals, for example bears, sleep through the winter.
cc.zh: 許多動物，例如熊，整個冬天都在睡覺。

cc.en: You should eat healthier food, for example fresh vegetables and fruit.
cc.zh: 你應該吃更健康的食物，例如新鮮蔬果。

cc.en: Some jobs, for instance nursing, require long and irregular hours.
cc.zh: 有些工作，例如護理，需要長時間且不規律的工時。

cc.en: Taiwan is famous for its night-market snacks, such as stinky tofu.
cc.zh: 台灣以夜市小吃聞名，例如臭豆腐。

cc.en: Two students were absent, namely Jack and Lily.
cc.zh: 有兩位學生缺席，即傑克和莉莉。

cc.en: The project has one major problem, namely a lack of funding.
cc.zh: 這個專案有一個大問題，即缺乏資金。

cc.en: Only one person can decide, namely the president.
cc.zh: 只有一個人能決定，也就是總統。

cc.en: The meeting is next Friday, that is, the 20th.
cc.zh: 會議在下週五，也就是二十號。

cc.en: He is a polyglot, that is, someone who speaks many languages.
cc.zh: 他是個多語者，也就是會說多種語言的人。

cc.en: He didn't pass the exam; in other words, he must take it again.
cc.zh: 他沒通過考試；換句話說，他必須重考。

cc.en: The company is cutting costs. In other words, some of us will lose our jobs.
cc.zh: 公司在削減成本。換句話說，我們有些人會失業。

cc.en: To put it another way, we need to spend less and save more.
cc.zh: 換個說法，我們需要少花錢、多存錢。

cc.en: To illustrate, consider what happens when interest rates rise.
cc.zh: 舉例來說，想想利率上升時會發生什麼。

cc.en: The rules are as follows: no food, no phones, no talking.
cc.zh: 規則如下：不准吃東西、不准用手機、不准說話。

cc.en: The report focuses on pollution, specifically plastic waste in the ocean.
cc.zh: 這份報告聚焦污染，特別是海洋中的塑膠垃圾。

cc.en: Everyone, including the teacher, laughed at the joke.
cc.zh: 每個人，包括老師，都被那個笑話逗笑了。

cc.en: The price covers everything, including meals and transportation.
cc.zh: 這個價格包含一切，包括餐食和交通。

cc.en: Leafy vegetables, like spinach, are rich in iron.
cc.zh: 葉菜類，像菠菜，富含鐵質。

cc.en: First of all, I would like to thank everyone for coming.
cc.zh: 首先，我想感謝大家的到來。

cc.en: First of all, read the question carefully before answering.
cc.zh: 首先，回答前要仔細讀題。

cc.en: To begin with, the hotel was far dirtier than the photos suggested.
cc.zh: 首先，這家飯店比照片上髒得多。

cc.en: Initially, the plan seemed perfect, but problems soon appeared.
cc.zh: 起初，計畫看似完美，但問題很快就出現了。

cc.en: At first I didn't like the city, but now I love it.
cc.zh: 起初我不喜歡這座城市，但現在我愛上了它。

cc.en: Mix the flour and eggs; then add the milk slowly.
cc.zh: 把麵粉和蛋混合；然後慢慢加入牛奶。

cc.en: Next, we will look at the causes of the problem.
cc.zh: 接下來，我們來看看這個問題的原因。

cc.en: We watched a movie and went for ice cream afterward.
cc.zh: 我們看了電影，之後去吃冰淇淋。

cc.en: Afterward, she regretted what she had said.
cc.zh: 事後，她後悔自己說過的話。

cc.en: He apologized afterwards, but the damage had been done.
cc.zh: 他事後道了歉，但傷害已經造成。

cc.en: He was arrested and subsequently charged with theft.
cc.zh: 他被逮捕，隨後被控竊盜。

cc.en: The company was sold and subsequently renamed.
cc.zh: 這家公司被出售，隨後更名。

cc.en: She moved to Canada in 2010 and lived there thereafter.
cc.zh: 她在2010年搬到加拿大，此後一直住在那裡。

cc.en: Boil the pasta; meanwhile, prepare the sauce.
cc.zh: 煮義大利麵；同時，準備醬料。

cc.en: The president met with leaders abroad. Meanwhile, protests grew at home.
cc.zh: 總統在國外會見領袖。與此同時，國內抗議擴大。

cc.en: The doctor will see you soon. In the meantime, please fill out this form.
cc.zh: 醫生很快就會看診。在此期間，請填寫這張表格。

cc.en: The new school opens next year; in the meantime, students use temporary classrooms.
cc.zh: 新學校明年開幕；在此期間，學生使用臨時教室。

cc.en: The repairs will take a week; in the meantime, use the back door.
cc.zh: 維修要一週；在此期間，請走後門。

cc.en: The two events were broadcast simultaneously on different channels.
cc.zh: 這兩個活動在不同頻道同時播出。

cc.en: He wants to save money, but at the same time he loves shopping.
cc.zh: 他想存錢，但同時他又愛購物。

cc.en: At the same time, we must not ignore the risks.
cc.zh: 同時，我們也不能忽視風險。

cc.en: She now works in Taipei; previously, she taught in Tainan.
cc.zh: 她現在在台北工作；先前，她在台南教書。

cc.en: The building, formerly a bank, is now a museum.
cc.zh: 這座建築先前是銀行，現在是博物館。

cc.en: Prior to the meeting, please read the attached report.
cc.zh: 會議之前，請閱讀附上的報告。

cc.en: Passengers must check in prior to departure.
cc.zh: 乘客必須在出發前辦理登機。

cc.en: If you plan to visit, please let us know beforehand.
cc.zh: 如果你打算來訪，請事先告知我們。

cc.en: After months of searching, he eventually found a job.
cc.zh: 找了好幾個月後，他終於找到工作。

cc.en: Ultimately, the decision rests with the school principal.
cc.zh: 最終，決定權在校長手上。

cc.en: The company ultimately failed because it ignored its customers.
cc.zh: 這家公司最終失敗，因為它忽視了顧客。

cc.en: Finally, I would like to thank my parents for their support.
cc.zh: 最後，我想感謝父母的支持。

cc.en: Lastly, remember to turn off the lights when you leave.
cc.zh: 最後，離開時記得關燈。

cc.en: Last but not least, I want to thank our volunteers.
cc.zh: 最後但同樣重要的是，我要感謝我們的志工。

cc.en: In the end, they decided to cancel the trip.
cc.zh: 最後，他們決定取消旅行。

cc.en: After hours of waiting, the train arrived at last.
cc.zh: 等了好幾個小時，火車終於來了。

cc.en: Once you have finished, please hand in your paper.
cc.zh: 一旦你完成了，請交卷。

cc.en: Once a popular singer, he now lives quietly in the countryside.
cc.zh: 他曾是當紅歌手，如今在鄉間過著平靜生活。

cc.en: Call me as soon as you arrive at the station.
cc.zh: 你一到車站就打給我。

cc.en: No sooner had she sat down than the phone rang.
cc.zh: 她剛坐下，電話就響了。

cc.en: Hardly had the game started when it began to pour.
cc.zh: 比賽剛開始，就下起了傾盆大雨。

cc.en: Not until he left did I realize how much I needed him.
cc.zh: 直到他離開，我才明白我多需要他。

cc.en: Wait here until I come back.
cc.zh: 在這裡等到我回來。

cc.en: Whenever I feel stressed, I go for a long walk.
cc.zh: 每當我感到壓力，我就去散步。

cc.en: By the time we arrived, the concert had already begun.
cc.zh: 我們到達時，演唱會已經開始了。

cc.en: Why did you buy the car in the first place?
cc.zh: 你當初為什麼買這輛車？

cc.en: I never wanted to come here in the first place.
cc.zh: 我一開始就不想來這裡。

cc.en: If it rains tomorrow, the picnic will be moved indoors.
cc.zh: 如果明天下雨，野餐將改到室內。

cc.en: If only I had listened to your advice!
cc.zh: 要是我當初聽了你的建議就好了！

cc.en: You will miss the bus unless you leave right now.
cc.zh: 除非你現在就出發，否則會錯過公車。

cc.en: Unless it rains, the match will start at three.
cc.zh: 除非下雨，否則比賽三點開始。

cc.en: You can borrow my car provided that you return it by Sunday.
cc.zh: 只要你週日前還車，就可以借我的車。

cc.en: Provided that everyone agrees, we will start next week.
cc.zh: 只要大家同意，我們下週就開始。

cc.en: I will lend you the money, providing that you pay me back soon.
cc.zh: 只要你很快還我，我就借錢給你。

cc.en: You can stay here as long as you keep the place clean.
cc.zh: 只要你保持環境整潔，就可以住在這裡。

cc.en: As long as you try your best, the result doesn't matter.
cc.zh: 只要你盡力，結果並不重要。

cc.en: So long as the weather holds, we will camp by the lake.
cc.zh: 只要天氣維持良好，我們就在湖邊露營。

cc.en: He agreed to help on condition that his name was kept secret.
cc.zh: 他同意幫忙，條件是不公開他的名字。

cc.en: Take an umbrella in case it rains later.
cc.zh: 帶把傘，以防稍後下雨。

cc.en: In case of fire, use the stairs, not the elevator.
cc.zh: 如遇火災，請走樓梯，不要搭電梯。

cc.en: In the event of an earthquake, stay away from windows.
cc.zh: 如果發生地震，要遠離窗戶。

cc.en: Suppose you won the lottery; what would you do first?
cc.zh: 假設你中了樂透；你會先做什麼？

cc.en: Supposing it snows, will the school still be open?
cc.zh: 假設下雪，學校還會開放嗎？

cc.en: Assuming that the train is on time, we will arrive by noon.
cc.zh: 假設火車準時，我們中午前會到。

cc.en: What if the plane is delayed and we miss the connection?
cc.zh: 如果飛機延誤、我們錯過轉機怎麼辦？

cc.en: Hurry up; otherwise, we will miss the beginning of the movie.
cc.zh: 快點；否則我們會錯過電影開頭。

cc.en: Wear a coat; otherwise, you will catch a cold.
cc.zh: 穿上外套；否則你會感冒。

cc.en: The food was a bit salty, but otherwise the meal was perfect.
cc.zh: 食物有點鹹，但除此之外這一餐很完美。

cc.en: Finish your homework now, or else you can't watch TV.
cc.zh: 現在做完功課，否則不能看電視。

cc.en: Whether you like it or not, you have to attend the meeting.
cc.zh: 不管你喜不喜歡，你都得參加會議。

cc.en: I don't know whether he will come or not.
cc.zh: 我不知道他會不會來。

cc.en: Even if you offered me a million dollars, I wouldn't sell it.
cc.zh: 即使你出一百萬，我也不賣。

cc.en: I will go to the concert even if it rains.
cc.zh: 即使下雨，我也會去聽演唱會。

cc.en: You will succeed only if you are willing to work hard.
cc.zh: 只有願意努力，你才會成功。

cc.en: Only if we act now can we save the forest.
cc.zh: 只有現在行動，我們才能救這片森林。

cc.en: Are you free this weekend? If so, let's go hiking.
cc.zh: 你這週末有空嗎？如果有，我們去爬山吧。

cc.en: Check whether the file is saved; if not, save it now.
cc.zh: 檢查檔案是否已儲存；如果沒有，現在就存。

cc.en: The situation hasn't improved; if anything, it has gotten worse.
cc.zh: 情況沒有好轉；如果真要說，反而更糟了。

cc.en: He isn't shy; if anything, he talks too much.
cc.zh: 他並不害羞；要說的話，他反而話太多。

cc.en: We will work overtime if necessary to meet the deadline.
cc.zh: 如有必要，我們會加班以趕上期限。

cc.en: Please reply by Friday, if possible.
cc.zh: 如果可能，請在週五前回覆。

cc.en: In sum, the project was costly but ultimately successful.
cc.zh: 總之，這個專案花費高昂，但最終成功。

cc.en: In summary, exercise benefits both the body and the mind.
cc.zh: 總而言之，運動對身心都有益。

cc.en: To sum up, we need more time and more money.
cc.zh: 總結來說，我們需要更多時間和金錢。

cc.en: In conclusion, I believe the new policy will benefit everyone.
cc.zh: 總之，我相信新政策會讓每個人受益。

cc.en: To conclude, let me thank everyone who made this possible.
cc.zh: 最後，讓我感謝所有促成此事的人。

cc.en: In short, the plan failed because nobody supported it.
cc.zh: 簡而言之，計畫失敗是因為沒人支持。

cc.en: In brief, the company needs to cut costs quickly.
cc.zh: 簡單地說，公司需要迅速削減成本。

cc.en: In a word, the trip was unforgettable.
cc.zh: 一句話，這趟旅行令人難忘。

cc.en: Briefly, the new law bans smoking in all public parks.
cc.zh: 簡單來說，新法禁止在所有公園吸菸。

cc.en: Overall, the students' performance has improved this year.
cc.zh: 整體而言，學生今年的表現有所進步。

cc.en: The service was slow, but overall the hotel was pleasant.
cc.zh: 服務很慢，但整體來說這家飯店令人愉快。

cc.en: On the whole, I think the new system works well.
cc.zh: 大體上，我認為新制度運作良好。

cc.en: All in all, it was a successful and enjoyable trip.
cc.zh: 總的來說，這是一次成功又愉快的旅行。

cc.en: In general, children learn languages faster than adults.
cc.zh: 一般來說，兒童學語言比成人快。

cc.en: Generally speaking, the climate here is mild all year round.
cc.zh: 一般而言，這裡的氣候全年溫和。

cc.en: By and large, the reviews of the film were positive.
cc.zh: 大體上，這部電影的評價是正面的。

cc.en: For the most part, the students behaved well on the trip.
cc.zh: 大部分時候，學生們在旅途中表現良好。

cc.en: The success of the project was largely due to teamwork.
cc.zh: 這個專案的成功主要歸功於團隊合作。

cc.en: The old theory has been largely abandoned.
cc.zh: 舊理論大致上已被捨棄。

cc.en: The audience was mostly young people in their twenties.
cc.zh: 觀眾大多是二十幾歲的年輕人。

cc.en: The course is mainly intended for beginners.
cc.zh: 這門課主要是為初學者設計的。

cc.en: The accident was partly caused by the slippery road.
cc.zh: 這起事故部分是由於路面滑所造成。

cc.en: I agree with you, but only partly.
cc.zh: 我同意你，但只是部分同意。

cc.en: Roughly speaking, half of the students passed the test.
cc.zh: 粗略地說，有一半的學生通過考試。

cc.en: The two cities are roughly the same size.
cc.zh: 這兩座城市大小大致相同。

cc.en: The first chapter was boring; likewise, the second put me to sleep.
cc.zh: 第一章很無聊；同樣地，第二章讓我睡著了。

cc.en: He donated generously, and his wife did likewise.
cc.zh: 他慷慨捐款，他太太也照做。

cc.en: Water the plants weekly; likewise, feed them once a month.
cc.zh: 每週澆水；同樣地，每月施肥一次。

cc.en: Cats need regular care; similarly, dogs require daily attention.
cc.zh: 貓需要定期照顧；同樣地，狗需要每天關注。

cc.en: Children copy their parents. In the same way, students imitate their teachers.
cc.zh: 孩子模仿父母。同樣地，學生模仿老師。

cc.en: Diet is important; equally, regular exercise matters.
cc.zh: 飲食很重要；同樣重要的是規律運動。

cc.en: Costs have risen, and prices have gone up correspondingly.
cc.zh: 成本上升，價格也隨之相應上漲。

cc.en: Last winter was mild. By comparison, this one has been bitterly cold.
cc.zh: 去年冬天溫和。相較之下，今年冷得刺骨。

cc.en: In comparison with last year, sales have grown by ten percent.
cc.zh: 與去年相比，銷售成長了百分之十。

cc.en: He prefers tea as opposed to coffee in the morning.
cc.zh: 早上他偏好喝茶而非咖啡。

cc.en: Unlike her sister, Amy is outgoing and loves parties.
cc.zh: 和她姐姐不同，艾咪外向又愛派對。

cc.en: The debate was about quality versus quantity.
cc.zh: 這場辯論是關於品質與數量之爭。

cc.en: Tonight's game is Taiwan versus Japan.
cc.zh: 今晚的比賽是台灣對日本。

cc.en: You can pay by card; alternatively, you can pay in cash.
cc.zh: 你可以刷卡；或者，你也可以付現。

cc.en: He is a teacher, or rather, a professor at the university.
cc.zh: 他是老師，更準確地說，是大學教授。

cc.en: You can either take the bus or walk to school.
cc.zh: 你可以搭公車，或者走路去學校。

cc.en: Neither the manager nor the staff knew about the change.
cc.zh: 經理和員工都不知道這項改變。

cc.en: He doesn't eat meat, nor does he drink milk.
cc.zh: 他不吃肉，也不喝牛奶。

cc.en: On the one hand, the city is exciting; on the other, it is exhausting.
cc.zh: 一方面，這座城市令人興奮；另一方面，它令人疲憊。

cc.en: The school has a system whereby students can earn extra credit.
cc.zh: 學校有一套制度，讓學生能藉此獲得額外學分。

cc.en: They signed an agreement whereby both sides share the costs.
cc.zh: 他們簽了一份協議，據此雙方分攤費用。

cc.en: He wrote a report wherein he explained the causes of the failure.
cc.zh: 他寫了一份報告，在其中解釋了失敗的原因。

cc.en: She announced her resignation, whereupon the room fell silent.
cc.zh: 她宣布辭職，隨即全場陷入沉默。

cc.en: I hereby declare the meeting open.
cc.zh: 我在此宣布會議開始。

cc.en: With regard to your question, I will answer it in writing.
cc.zh: 關於你的問題，我會以書面回覆。

cc.en: Please contact us regarding any problems with your order.
cc.zh: 關於訂單的任何問題，請與我們聯繫。

cc.en: He said nothing regarding his future plans.
cc.zh: 關於未來的計畫，他什麼也沒說。

cc.en: There are many rumors concerning the actor's private life.
cc.zh: 有許多關於這位演員私生活的傳聞。

cc.en: Concerning your request, we need a few more days to decide.
cc.zh: 關於你的請求，我們需要再幾天決定。

cc.en: The food was excellent. As for the service, it was slow.
cc.zh: 食物很棒。至於服務，就慢了。

cc.en: There is some doubt as to whether the plan will work.
cc.zh: 這個計畫是否可行仍有疑慮。

cc.en: In terms of price, this phone is the best choice.
cc.zh: 就價格而言，這款手機是最佳選擇。

cc.en: As far as I am concerned, the matter is closed.
cc.zh: 就我而言，這件事已經結束了。

cc.en: As far as cost is concerned, the plan is unrealistic.
cc.zh: 就成本而言，這個計畫不切實際。

cc.en: When it comes to cooking, my father is the expert.
cc.zh: 說到做菜，我爸爸才是專家。

cc.en: Apart from a few spelling mistakes, the essay is excellent.
cc.zh: 除了幾個拼字錯誤，這篇文章很棒。

cc.en: Apart from English, what other languages do you speak?
cc.zh: 除了英語，你還會說什麼語言？

cc.en: Aside from the price, I have no complaints about the car.
cc.zh: 除了價格，我對這輛車沒什麼抱怨。

cc.en: Everyone passed the test except for two students.
cc.zh: 除了兩位學生，大家都通過了考試。

cc.en: I know nothing about him other than his name.
cc.zh: 除了名字，我對他一無所知。

cc.en: Dinner is not ready; in the meantime, help yourself to some snacks.
cc.zh: 晚餐還沒好；在此期間，請自己拿點心吃。

cc.en: Presumably, the meeting has been canceled, since nobody is here.
cc.zh: 大概是會議取消了，因為沒人在這裡。

cc.en: He left early, presumably to catch his train.
cc.zh: 他提早離開，大概是去趕火車。

cc.en: The castle is supposedly haunted, but I don't believe it.
cc.zh: 據說這座城堡有鬼，但我不信。

cc.en: The new medicine is supposedly very effective.
cc.zh: 據說這種新藥非常有效。

cc.en: Apparently, the store closes early on Sundays.
cc.zh: 顯然，這家店週日提早關門。

cc.en: She has apparently decided to quit her job.
cc.zh: 她顯然已決定辭職。

cc.en: The seemingly simple question puzzled everyone.
cc.zh: 這個看似簡單的問題難倒了所有人。

cc.en: She is arguably the best player of her generation.
cc.zh: 她可以說是她那一代最棒的球員。

cc.en: Somehow, the cat managed to open the door by itself.
cc.zh: 不知怎地，那隻貓竟然自己把門打開了。

cc.en: We will finish the job somehow.
cc.zh: 我們總會想辦法完成這份工作。

cc.en: He had barely left the house when it started to rain.
cc.zh: 他剛離開家就開始下雨了。

cc.en: There was barely enough food for everyone.
cc.zh: 食物幾乎不夠所有人吃。

cc.en: Scarcely had she opened the book when the lights went out.
cc.zh: 她剛打開書，燈就熄了。

cc.en: I could scarcely believe my eyes.
cc.zh: 我幾乎不敢相信自己的眼睛。

cc.en: Hardly anyone came to the meeting because of the storm.
cc.zh: 由於暴風雨，幾乎沒人來開會。

cc.en: It is hardly surprising that he failed; he never studied.
cc.zh: 他不及格並不令人意外；他從不讀書。

cc.en: No doubt you have heard the news already.
cc.zh: 你無疑已經聽到消息了。

cc.en: She is, without doubt, the hardest-working person I know.
cc.zh: 她無疑是我認識最努力的人。

cc.en: By all means, bring your friends to the party.
cc.zh: 當然可以，帶你的朋友來派對吧。

cc.en: The problem is by no means solved.
cc.zh: 這個問題絕對還沒解決。

cc.en: By no means should you open that door.
cc.zh: 你絕對不可以打開那扇門。

cc.en: The delay was in no way our fault.
cc.zh: 這次延誤絕非我們的錯。

cc.en: On no account should the password be shared.
cc.zh: 絕不可分享密碼。

cc.en: Under no circumstances will refunds be given.
cc.zh: 無論在任何情況下都不退款。

cc.en: Nowhere is the problem more serious than in big cities.
cc.zh: 這個問題在大城市最為嚴重。

cc.en: The missing keys were nowhere to be found.
cc.zh: 遺失的鑰匙到處都找不到。

cc.en: The product is cheaper here than elsewhere in the city.
cc.zh: 這個產品在這裡比城裡其他地方便宜。

cc.en: If the hotel is full, we will have to look elsewhere.
cc.zh: 如果飯店滿了，我們得去別處找。

cc.en: Nowadays, most people shop online rather than in stores.
cc.zh: 如今，大多數人在網路上購物而非在店裡。

cc.en: Nothing lasts forever, not even the hardest rock.
cc.zh: 沒有什麼是永恆的，即使是最硬的岩石。

cc.en: He is forever complaining about the weather.
cc.zh: 他老是在抱怨天氣。

cc.en: The manager will be with you shortly.
cc.zh: 經理很快就會來見你。

cc.en: Shortly after midnight, the power went out.
cc.zh: 午夜過後不久，就停電了。

cc.en: Have you seen any good movies lately?
cc.zh: 你最近有看什麼好電影嗎？

cc.en: Let's have lunch together sometime next week.
cc.zh: 我們下週找個時間一起吃午餐吧。

cc.en: Someday, I hope to travel around the world.
cc.zh: 總有一天，我希望能環遊世界。

cc.en: We flew to London via Hong Kong.
cc.zh: 我們經由香港飛往倫敦。

cc.en: Send me the file via email, please.
cc.zh: 請透過電子郵件把檔案寄給我。

cc.en: Students work alongside professionals during the internship.
cc.zh: 實習期間，學生與專業人士並肩工作。

cc.en: The new drug is used alongside traditional treatments.
cc.zh: 這種新藥與傳統療法一併使用。

cc.en: In the midst of the crisis, the mayor remained calm.
cc.zh: 在危機之中，市長保持冷靜。

cc.en: The company closed amid growing financial problems.
cc.zh: 這家公司在日益嚴重的財務問題中倒閉。

cc.en: Beneath his calm appearance, he was extremely nervous.
cc.zh: 在他冷靜的外表下，他其實極度緊張。

cc.en: She felt the job was beneath her.
cc.zh: 她覺得這份工作配不上她。
